legalities (table)
- id: INTEGER NOT NULL
- format: TEXT
- status: TEXT
- uuid: TEXT
PRIMARY KEY (id)
FOREIGN KEY (uuid) REFERENCES cards (uuid)

arguments.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.name) AS card_count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.manaCost = '{0}'
  AND l.format = 'commander'
  AND l.status = 'Legal';
